verdict.rationale: Parahelp lets ops describe support flows, including policies, knowledge and tool connections, in natural language, and the Internal Agent builds the configuration. Guardrails express conditional rules, such as routing enterprise-account tickets to the enterprise team and gating refunds above $100 behind approval. However, the docs never describe explicit step-by-step SOP definitions or guaranteed deterministic branching; flows appear to be agent-interpreted natural-language configurations. Missing for 10: an explicit step-sequenced SOP or playbook format, documented deterministic branching logic (decision trees or conditions) beyond guardrail rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I encode standard operating procedures the agent follows step-by-step for known issue types, with deterministic branching

citations.quote: Describe the flow you want in natural language - the policies, knowledge, and tool connections it combines - and the Internal Agent configures it.
Describe the support flow you want, and the Internal Agent builds it.
